notes: On-station RCBD (Federal University Dutse, 2018 dry season, 3 reps) comparing AWD (re-flood at 15 cm below surface) with continuous flooding. Reports only soil properties, growth/yield components and paddy yield (Figure 2, ~9000 vs ~5800 kg/ha). The abstract and conclusion claim AWD can reduce costs and keep profitability, but no cost, return, price, number of irrigations or other economic value is reported anywhere, and no adoption or carbon data. Also note: the AWD arm was managed as 'the SRI method' (young seedlings, wider spacing) while CF was 'common practice', so the contrast is closer to sri than to awd alone (vocabulary: AWD inside an SRI package goes to sri).
